source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Malicious code/software/activity: Malicious injection
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Production (Manufacturing systems & Simulators & Crypto hw/sw) & Centralised Checkout Systems & Satellite Operations Centre (Mission Control System)
description: Injection of malicious software (e.g. rootkits, bootkits, backdoors) into space operations contorl systems and/or satellite data receivers and trasmitters. Malicious code could also be injected into software updates, affecting for exmaple on-orbit software updates, upgrades, patches, or direct memory writes. Malicious injection could enable satellite data extraction and/or manipluation targeting the bus or payload.

projection.lifecycle_rule: ET-P-LC-01 (legacy tuple L field; Annex C has no lifecycle column)
